maxItems.title: Max processes to extract
maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of processes returned this run. The unfiltered backlog is very large (25,000+ processes at audit time, 10 per page) - this actor does not yet expose the advanced-search filters (date range, organism, process type) seen on the source's own form, since their exact parameter values were not live-verified before v1 shipped. Start small; raise gradually.
